reason-claim-mismatch: The numbers sent did not match the replay
reason-end-mismatch: The replay ended differently from the run
reason-error: The server hit an error while checking the run
reason-illegal-event: The recording held an input the game does not allow
reason-invalid-log: The recording of the run was not readable
reason-no-run: The server had no record of this run
reason-setup-mismatch: The run did not start the way the server issued it
reason-stale-sim: The game was updated during the run, so it could not be replayed
reason-step-mismatch: The replay took a different number of steps
reason-timeout: The replay took too long to check
reason-too-long: The run lasted longer than the time it took
reason-unknown: The run could not be checked
signed-out: Sign in to see your runs
